art_direction: Premium Dark Mode Neo-Brutalist with Electric Accents

colors.instructions: Implement dark mode as default. Use #09090B (deep midnight) for background. Primary accent is an electric neon yellow (#D9F844) to provide a stark, high-end contrast to the dark theme.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
scale.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-mono

typography.setup_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for Inter and JetBrains Mono. Use Fontshare API or custom font-face for Cabinet Grotesk. Enforce tight tracking on all headings and aggressive uppercase styling for hero texts.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-32). Use negative space aggressively to focus attention on typography and select images.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 for major sections. Overlap elements to break grid symmetry.
layout_and_spacing.section_padding: py-24 md:py-32 for main sections. Ensure seamless transitions between sections.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, clipPath/overflow hidden wrappers).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_effects: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Implement parallax scroll on abstract images.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-interactions on all cards (subtle scale, border color shift to primary). Magnetic button effect for primary CTAs.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on Sticky Header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #27272A (border-border). Sharp edges or very slight rounding (rounded-md max).
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain SVG overlay across the entire page with pointer-events-none and opacity-20.

components.hero: Massive typography. Slogan 'YOUR VISION. OUR TECH.' broken onto multiple lines with kinetic reveal. Floating 3D abstract object or subtle glowing gradient orb in background.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee reading 'TECHY POTATO • AWARD WINNING DIGITAL AGENCY • ' separated by stars. Font-mono, text-sm, muted text color.
components.about_services: Bento grid layout. High contrast cards. Hover reveals more text. Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or thin).
components.testimonials: Editorial layout, massive quotes with 'Cabinet Grotesk', small client avatars. No generic carousels; use a staggered list or a fade-in-place transition.
components.footer: Massive footer typography. Darkest background. High contrast links.

images.description: Abstract metallic sculpture for premium hero 3D accent
Neon abstract fluid for technology services card background
Creative modern office for 'About Us' section
Smiling professional team for Client Testimonials or Why Choose Us

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary neon text meets 4.5:1 ratio against dark background. Use black text inside primary-colored buttons.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query for all framer-motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls behind it. Always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent bg.
Ensure buttons are sharp or subtly rounded (rounded-sm) to match the neo-brutalist vibe, with distinct hover states.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for sharp, premium iconography.
instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to support the custom colors and extended spacing.
Inject a grain/noise SVG pattern across the App.
Build a masked text reveal animation component for the hero text 'YOUR VISION. OUR TECH.'
Create a Marquee component using framer-motion or a simple CSS keyframe.
Implement Sections: Hero, About, Services, Why Us, Portfolio, Testimonials, Process, Pricing, FAQ, Contact, Footer.
Do NOT use generic shadcn cards if they compromise the custom editorial aesthetic. Build custom raw div/section layouts with Tailwind.
